description: Etsy's own sales count (transaction_sold_count: total sales of the shop, not per listing), active listings, favorites and opening year for up to 5 Etsy shops. No revenue estimate. Use for 'how many sales does this Etsy shop have?' and comparing competitors. If Growtsy has read a shop before, `history` gives the change in Etsy's sales count since that first read, with its date and number of days (the difference of two Etsy counts, not an estimate).

shops.description: Up to 5 Etsy shop names or links, as an array or a comma-separated string

name: etsy_shop_sales
title: Etsy shop sales count
